title: quenched post-workout german oysters grill
description: grassy, velvety, post-workout german dish featuring oysters, a grill, and a hint of Asian-inspired freshness. Great for a quick dinner after a tough workout at the local buddhist temple.
instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a grill pan over medium-high heat.
add 2 cloves of garlic, minced, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
add 2 inches of sliced ginger and cook for another minute.
add the oysters, closed side down, and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to open.
add 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, 1 tablespoon of honey, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar to the pan.
toss the oysters to coat evenly with the sauce and cook for another 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the oysters are cooked through.
season with black pepper to taste.
serve immediately, garnished with a sprinkle of lemon zest if desired.
